name: proof-pr-repo
description: AI PR intake gate for maintainers: decide whether a pull request is ready for human review.

scripts.benchmark: pnpm --filter @proof-pr/core build && pnpm --filter proof-pr build && node packages/cli/dist/index.js benchmark --cases benchmarks/cases
scripts.benchmark:report: pnpm --filter @proof-pr/core build && pnpm --filter proof-pr build && node packages/cli/dist/index.js benchmark --cases benchmarks/cases --format markdown --output benchmarks/report.md
scripts.release:check: pnpm typecheck && pnpm test && pnpm build && pnpm benchmark && pnpm pack:cli
